status: additive deterministic symbolic seven-band eighteen-site analytical-cubit overlay

grammar.packet: {| concatenated ascending position labels |} with optional second trailing | for the declared dual seam

dualClosure.semantics: two-port symbolic seam / bind boundary; NOT two extra numbered sites

grammar.parseWithoutSeparators: Decode number runs against expected monotonic 1..18 labels; never reinterpret '910' as 910

bandConvention: Seven named, non-equidistant mnemonic ROYGBIV-like RGB/HSV display bands. Approximate hue selections; NOT a wavelength/spectral-power distribution or a chemical/force measurement.

bands.name: Blue
bands.segmentRole: five-slot core; declared double || exit seam

slotStrengthRule.formula: position n: n%3=1 -> W; n%3=2 -> M; n%3=0 -> S
slotStrengthRule.strengthMeaning: display brightness only; not weak/medium/strong fundamental particle interactions

witnessBridge.perPosition: Create exact Gen g, index i, W|M|S record, attach ordinal position and packet id, then run all four source-derived software quad projections
witnessBridge.acceptance: 3/4 software report quorum; no claim of instrument independence
witnessBridge.sourceIdentityProtected: The source swatch and canonical cubit structure cannot be changed by simulated report faults.

guardrails: ROYGBIV is used as a seven-band visual mnemonic; each hex/Hue selection is display-only and does not specify a spectral wavelength.
Bracket grammar, pipe boundary, port-count and labels are symbolic software constructs, not physical analytical qubit states or a measured 18-particle chain.
The doubled closing pipes after position 15 are retained verbatim and do not create positions 19 or 20.
The seven color bands are NOT the four CERN detector quads. Four observers inspect each of 18 slots as independent software functions of one source, not independent detector readings.
Weak Medium Strong are symbolic display intensities and do not denote three actual fundamental forces.
The previous Gen0/Gen1 historical start dates and 370-color source register remain unchanged.
